# Real National Park Service map fixtures

These are source maps published by the National Park Service (NPS). NPS states that its maps are in the public domain on its [Data Sources and Accuracy for NPS Maps](https://www.nps.gov/subjects/gisandmapping/data-sources-and-accuracy.htm) page. The [NPS website disclaimer](https://www.nps.gov/aboutus/disclaimer.htm) also says NPS-created material is generally public domain unless otherwise indicated. No source map here carries a separate copyright notice.

| Fixture | Source | Map page | Challenge |
|---|---|---:|---|
| `dickey-ridge.pdf` | [Dickey Ridge Area Road and Trail Map](https://www.nps.gov/shen/planyourvisit/upload/DickeyRidgeArea_RoadTrail.pdf), Shenandoah National Park, 6/2019 | 1 of 2 | Dashed black hiking trails amid black roads, gray streams, and labels |
| `acadia-carriage-roads.pdf` | [Carriage Road User's Map](https://www.nps.gov/acad/planyourvisit/upload/CRUMmap_508.pdf), Acadia National Park | 1 of 2 | White carriage roads across grayscale terrain, inset duplicate map, numbered junctions |
| `zion-wilderness.pdf` | [Zion Wilderness Map](https://www.nps.gov/zion/planyourvisit/upload/Map-Page.pdf), Zion National Park | 1 of 1 | Colored and dotted hiking routes across shaded terrain, rivers, and labels |

The PDF files preserve the published maps. The checked-in PNGs are page 1 rendered at 1.5 raster pixels per PDF point (108 dpi): Dickey Ridge 918×1188, Acadia 1188×1836, and Zion 1458×2376. Rendering used PyMuPDF. The JSON truth files contain one visibly marked route sample per map, traced by hand from the rendered pixels, plus hand-placed map anchors. Each anchor's coordinate comes from a named real-world location; placement on a diagram can be approximate. Anchor fits are not part of the line-following quality score.

Coordinate sources: Dickey Ridge Visitor Center from an [NPS event location](https://www.nps.gov/planyourvisit/event-details.htm?id=C097FD30-962C-ECA9-B71DF095DE378DDD); Signal Knob Overlook from [NGA geographical names](https://geographic.org/geographic_names/usaname.php?fid=usageo_1374&uni=1474583); Dickey Hill from [USGS-derived TopoZone](https://www.topozone.com/virginia/warren-va/summit/dickey-hill-2/); Snead Barn from [OpenStreetMap via Mapcarta](https://mapcarta.com/W407401596). Acadia's three anchors are from the [NPS WGS84 coordinate table](https://www.nps.gov/acad/planyourvisit/directions.htm). Zion's visitor centers are from [NPS directions](https://www.nps.gov/zion/planyourvisit/directions.htm), Lava Point from [OpenStreetMap via Mapcarta](https://mapcarta.com/N1814607958), and Temple of Sinawava from [USGS-derived TopoZone](https://www.topozone.com/utah/washington-ut/basin/temple-of-sinawava/).

`tests/bench/run.ts` auto-traces the marked route's color in a fixed region bounded by the hand trace plus 30 pixels on each side. The local region includes crossings, labels, nearby lines and discontinuities while excluding unrelated trail networks elsewhere on the sheet. It computes length-weighted recall and precision within 5 pixels against the hand trace. The first measured baselines were 87.565%/29.375% for Dickey Ridge, 100%/51.884% for Acadia, and 100%/76.016% for Zion. T-115 tuned the Acadia profile to tolerance 60, gap 0 px, minimum length 50 px (100%/89.951%) and Zion to tolerance 40, gap 8 px, minimum length 50 px (100%/99.944%). Dickey Ridge retains its initial profile. Each fixture gates at its current recorded baseline minus three percentage points. These rows measure the selected route sample, not every trail on the source map.

T-116 also reports a non-gating row for each marked route using `newProject` defaults and the marked ink color as the picked chip. The gap and minimum length come from the full working-map dimensions, while scoring uses the same route region as the tuned row. Initial default-profile results are Dickey Ridge 87.565% recall / 30.240% precision (tolerance 60, gap 15 px, minimum length 47.52 px), Acadia 100% / 76.023% (60, 23 px, 73.44 px), and Zion 100% / 78.612% (60, 30 px, 95.04 px). These rows track user-visible defaults without changing the tuned fixture gates.
